STORYTIME & PRE-READING WORKSHEETS

Storytime & Pre-Reading worksheets — free printables for age 4.

Sequencing, clues, feelings and retelling — the paper twins of the Storytime Adventures, with draw-and-tell panels. Every sheet twins with a real game in Storytime & Pre-Reading Comprehension (Class 29) — download the PDF, print from the page, or play online.
